results.title: Supporting Cocktail Chemistry
results.author: Cocktail Chemistry
results.text: Hey everyone its Nick just checking in. I hope you guys have had as much fun watching these videos as I have been making them. It is a side hobby for me and one that is quite expensive and time-consuming and so a lot of you have asked me to set up a Patreon page to chip in a couple bucks to make sure we can continue to do this going forward. So i just wanted to give you a little insight into what I do and my process. So i basically film on my iphone in my kitchen at home, but I invest a lot in top-quality liquors that I love and want to recommend to you guys. As well as equipment that I use whether it's a smoking gun or immersion circulator for cool infusions and high-quality glassware. And I spend a lot of time doing things like ice experiments and other things of that nature so it's time-consuming and expensive and I want to make sure i can continue to do this and put out a regular cadence of videos for you guys. So you can head on over to my Patreon page to learn a little bit more and if you want to donate a couple bucks that would go a long way to making sure we can keep this up over the next year. With that money I'll be able to hopefully invest in some better equipment we can get a better camera some better lighting, i'm going to be able to put out a video a week at least and also have a direct connection to you guys there and will will be prioritizing suggestions from my Patreon patrons. So head on over and would love to keep this going with your support. Thanks!

results.title: Cocktail Elements Introduction
results.author: Linden Leaf Botanicals
results.text:
My name's Max Venning. I'm the co-owner 
of Three Sheets with my brother Noel. So we opened Three Sheets 
about four years ago in London. We're on the Top 50 Bars list - 
have been for the last three years. We work with high quality products. We like 
simple elegant drinks with clean flavours. It needs to be simple, it needs to be delicious. We just want to have people in here enjoying 
their cocktails, having a good time. We look keenly at any waste we produce and the 
sustainability of the products that we use. Linden Leaf really excites me as a project. You've got these three scientists from 
Cambridge. They're really into food and drink, and they're applying that scientific 
knowledge onto the extraction of flavours, refining it through the application 
of molecular flavour extraction to create something that's more modern 
and more relevant to today's market. The Cocktail Element series really inspires me. It's certified organic and it's 
taking fruit from the peak season, distilling it, pulling out exactly the 
right flavours that we need from it, and then that's available all year round in an 
atomizer that we can spray on the top of drinks. The sprays are so special because 
the hyper-concentrated flavour means that we've got an exact replica of 
peak season lemon for 12 months a year. You're getting not only the best flavor, but you're also getting those products
